reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) is from a single study on an SLM-fabricated HEA, not a refractory HEA like HfMoNbTaTiZr. It supports the mechanism and quantitative improvements for that specific system, but provides no direct evidence for refractory HEAs, leaving the key premise of applicability to refractory systems unsupported.
premises: Serrated grain boundaries can be induced by slow cooling that coarsens precipitates to interact with mobile grain boundaries.
Serrated grain boundaries distribute strain more homogeneously than straight grain boundaries.
Homogeneous strain distribution from serrated boundaries increases tensile fracture strain by ~3.5x at 650°C.
Homogeneous strain distribution from serrated boundaries reduces minimum creep strain rate by >90% at 650°C.
These mechanisms and improvements apply to precipitation-strengthened refractory HEAs like HfMoNbTaTiZr.
